Plattkofel, also known as Sassolungo in Italian, is a prominent mountain in the Dolomites of South Tyrol, Italy. It is part of the Sella Group, a mountain range that is well-known for its distinctive rock formations and stunning alpine landscapes. Plattkofel/Sassolungo has an elevation of 3,181 meters (10,433 feet) and is a popular destination for hikers, climbers, and nature enthusiasts.

The mountain is characterized by its steep, jagged rock faces and towering peaks, making it a challenging but rewarding location for mountaineering activities. The surrounding area offers a variety of hiking trails, ranging from easy walks to more technical routes that require a higher level of skill and experience.

Plattkofel/Sassolungo is also a popular destination for skiing and snowboarding in the winter months, with a number of ski resorts located nearby. The mountain is a striking presence in the landscape and is a symbol of the natural beauty and rugged terrain of the Dolomites.

Overall, Plattkofel/Sassolungo is a must-visit destination for outdoor enthusiasts looking to experience the breathtaking scenery and unique geology of the Dolomites in South Tyrol.
